title: Claims Accepted, Arrears Standing and the Share of a Payment Released
content:
An enrolment on the Keyturn Host Protection Plan that has drawn a number of accepted claims while a share stands unpaid on it has part of a payment held back.

- Where the claims accepted on the enrolment in the twelve months before reach the number the plan allows before cover is suspended and a share stands unpaid on the enrolment, the payment is released at the marketplace's high-exposure release share of 70 percent.
- Where they reach the number the plan allows before review but not the number before suspension and a share stands unpaid, it is released at the marketplace's reviewed-exposure share of 85 percent.
- In every other case no share is taken on that account.

### The two numbers each plan publishes

| Plan | Claims allowed before review | Claims allowed before suspension |
|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 2 | 4 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 2 | 4 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 3 | 5 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 3 | 5 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 4 | 6 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 5 | 8 |

### Worked readings (hypothetical, on the Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan, whose numbers are 4 and 6)

| Accepted claims in the twelve months before | Share standing unpaid | Released at |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | some | 70 percent |
| 4 | some | 85 percent |
| 6 | none | the whole of it |
| 3 | either | the whole of it |

Nothing is taken on that account where nothing stands unpaid, however many claims have been accepted.

### Where the reading is taken from

The claims counted are the appraisals accepted on this enrolment within the twelve months before, and what stands unpaid is the amount owed by the host on the enrolment.
